references.title: DWDS: desto
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Form: Konjunktion before a comparative; Etymologie: ahd. thesthiu, a fused case form of the demonstrative

notes.rationale: »Desto besser.«, 'so much the better'. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root desto alone.
